Episode 150. When It's Time to Pay the Price (3)
The most disgraceful death in the history of the Empire.
That's how the news around the world described the Emperor's end.

Since the birth of the Empire, there have been times when the Biment Imperial family's position was threatened, or when an emperor was dethroned for his tyranny, but none met as pitiful an end as Amir Biment.
Amir Biment was the first emperor who was not given a funeral after death.
Instead, the people wanted to leave the square, where Amir was left as a large stain, as a lesson for the Biment heirs.
Near where the stain of what used to be Amir remained, there were many big and small stones thrown by the people.
Those stones will not be removed in the future.
It was an ugly sight that didn't fit with the beautiful and clean palace square, but the people of Biment were proud of it.

Although they could only boo when the Emperor drove Hyran into treason and didn't take action, they were glad that they could now show that they have always supported Hyran more than the royal family.
Understandably, Dante didn't find the sight of the people disgusting or hypocritical.
"If there is one thing the deceased Amir Biment did well, it was that he allowed the people to voice their opinions."
Dante said, pouring tea into the cup in front of him. One of the two cups was for Kashmir.
"He hardly ever listened to them, but I admit that he didn't kill or suppress them just for speaking out. Many emperors couldn't even do that."
"Sir Kashmir."
"Yes, Sir Dante."
"You must have heard stories from Jin."
Dante didn't ask what he thought about ascending to the throne after the empire was normalized. It seemed as if he had no right to refuse.
"Why me?"
"Aren't you a royal family member? Moreover, you are with the heads of the seven families, the Rainbow Coalition, who have not forgotten their loyalty to the empire, not just to the royal family."
Kashmir's original surname is not Alphrion but Biment, and he is the younger brother of Amir Biment, the dethroned emperor.
Dante believed that his ruling the empire would be more akin to performing his duty as a royal family member, rather than gaining power.
In other words, it's about paying the price as a member of the royal family. By becoming an excellent ruler.

"There is no one among the remaining trash of the royal family who can take responsibility for this matter. The reason I requested to see you is not to ask for your opinion. I just wanted to have a conversation with you once. And..."
Dante bowed his head once.
"I also wanted to express my personal apologies."
"Why such feelings towards me?"
"Because you too needed a chance for revenge."
Jin is waiting for the day when Kashmir will personally tell him why he became a dethroned emperor, but Dante already knew.

Dante is currently the master of Hyran. Therefore, he could see all the information Hyran had, and while many records were lost with the destruction of the Sword Emperor Castle, documents about Kashmir were still here in the second Hyran Castle.
According to those records, Kashmir became a dethroned emperor due to the direct scheming of Amir Biment.
It's a common story. Kashmir lost his loved ones in the process, and with his remaining loyal subjects, almost disabled, and Alisa, he settled in Tikan.
It wasn't something he couldn't tell Jin, but Kashmir was still struggling to recall that memory.

"...It would be a lie to say I had none, but taking revenge on Amir Biment is just a part of my life. If revenge was everything, I would have long revealed to the world what he did to me and my family back then, how he drove me out using the people as a shield."
Hoo, Kashmir let out a long breath.
"So, you don't need to feel sorry for me. Let's get to the point. I believe you want to discuss politics with me."
"Yes, that's correct."
"You've announced the declaration of your rule for tomorrow."
"Yes."
"Move it to right now."
Dante's eyes widened.
"For what reason?"

"If my guess is correct, the royal family will release an article about the deceased Amir Biment today. Not just mocking and laughing at his death like other news outlets, but stating that his tyranny had nothing to do with the royal family."
That was a problem Dante had already anticipated. He had a plan to respond calmly, but Kashmir had a different idea.

"From the start, your rule cannot seem weaker than the royal family's. Even though it's a day earlier than the official announcement, fewer people may show up at your rally, but it doesn't matter since public sentiment is already in your favor."
"Weaker."
"If the royal family starts cutting their losses right after your declaration, it will look like they're hitting back at you. Especially the nobles, they will definitely see it that way."
"But if we move the announcement up by a day, won't it look like we're breaking our promise to the people from the start?"
"Good point. It's certainly not good to make that choice just because you don't want them to make the first move."
If the declaration is moved up by a day, the royal family will also hastily release an article in response.
Dante broke his promise, and the tyranny was all the emperor's personal deviation.
However, the Bamel Federation had one card that the royal family didn't know about.
"It's a trap. Once the royal family starts to react to the unexpectedly early declaration of rule, we will present one irrefutable piece of evidence that they participated in the emperor's madness."
"Evidence?"
When Kashmir explained what it was, Dante's eyes widened.
"Indeed... As expected, it seems that my choice to entrust the empire to you in the future was correct. I have no ability in the realm of politics and governance."

"Well, from what I see, you possess a power similar to that of Jin Gongja. The power to draw people in. That's why, despite the revelation that Hyran had the White Stone, you are still loved by the people."
The White Stone was real, and it caused chaos throughout the empire.
In fact, just by possessing the White Stone, regardless of how it came about, Hyran could have incurred the wrath of the people.
Even if Gliac could not have awakened without the help of Zifel and the emperor.
"If there is such a power, it would be a power possessed not by me, but by my grandfather, and all of Hyran."
"Anyway, let's go. Let's get a hit on those disgusting mystics."
The prediction that fewer people would flock to the declaration of rule was nothing but a guess.
As soon as Dante left the second castle of Hyran and began to move, the people waiting for him surged into the palace like a tidal wave.
When the emperor branded Hyran a traitor, he looked down at the people from a huge golden palanquin.
Dante stood on the stones piled up by the people.
"From today until the normalization of the empire, I, Dante Hyran, will rule on behalf of Amir Biment's illegitimate son, Kuron Biment."
The people let out cheers as if they had been waiting, and the royal retainers who hastily came out to the square twisted their faces.
But their faces were yet to distort.

"There will be no occasion for Kuron Biment to formally ascend to the throne. He will exist as a puppet for formality until my rule ends, and when the time comes, he will be stripped of his qualifications and return as a commoner."
The advice to openly talk about Kuron being a puppet was given by Kashmir on the way here.
"What, what is this! This is an insult to the royal family!"
"Prince Kuron has nothing to do with this incident! He is just nine years old. He did not participate in Amir Biment's wickedness."
"Regardless of the reason, you must be aware of the damage caused to the empire by the White Stone. Do you think Hyran is qualified to usurp the throne?"
A few nobles raised their voices.

"Hyiran does not usurp the throne. It's impossible for a family other than Bument to ascend to the throne. So, until a clean royal family member that everyone can acknowledge appears, I will actively support his ascension to the throne."
"Ha! In the end, are you saying that after Ku-ron, you plan to rule the empire behind the scenes with another puppet?"
Dante locked eyes with the noble who said this.
He flinched momentarily at the killing intent he felt from Dante.

"Do you not know the loyalty of the Hyiran family that history has proven over such a long time? If we wanted to do that, Hyiran would have become a new royal family long ago. Even now, when my grandfather is not here, it's entirely possible."
As Dante raised his spirit, a vibration spread throughout the area. Having received all of Ron's true energy, and having been freed from the chaos, he was now showing an incomparably enormous energy.

"Is there currently a way for the royal family to stop me? It would be difficult even to borrow the power of Zifl. The reason I still keep the rotten royal family and the nobles of the empire alive is not because I've let go of my anger... it's just that you guys still have things to do on this land."
"Fine, let's correct your action as usurping power, not the throne. But remember, the public may be on Hyiran's side now, but illegitimate usurpation will eventually turn public sentiment!"
With that, the nobles left the square on trembling legs. They had to go back and prepare their responses.
Dante turned his gaze back to the people.

"The first thing I will do as a regent is to move the capital. This does not mean moving all administrative facilities and institutions from the palace, but simply choosing the territory of the Black Emperor's Castle as a symbolic capital."
The people murmured. Moving the capital to the Black Emperor's Castle seemed like a real power grab, just like the nobles said.

"Currently, the Black Emperor's Castle has become a land of death where entry is even impossible due to the aftermath of the chaos, but there is a light that can purify the contaminated empire. In a few months, it will be possible to observe this light, so please check it out. If you find the symbolic capital move unreasonable after seeing it, I will withdraw. And the second thing I will do is..."
A sadness filled Dante's eyes.
"A joint funeral. From today, for the next ten days, we will hold a national funeral to commemorate those who fought for the empire and Hyiran, and we will build a memorial stone."
Everyone agreed to this part.
It was time to pay the price for those who had committed atrocities and those who had defended the empire against them.

"The third is, we will focus on purifying the contaminated areas. After finishing these three tasks, I will step down from being a regent and return to defending the empire as the lord of the Black Emperor's Castle."

From that day on, short and bold statements from Dante about his regency and articles about the situation in the empire poured out. And as Kashimir predicted, the royal family began to immediately cut off the tail of being an emperor.
As soon as articles stating that the royal family and the emperor were unrelated poured out, evidence 'proving their bond' arrived in the empire.
It was the corpse of Mine that Jin had obtained in the Wontaramo forest in the past and left with Valeria.
